item.title: Fly-tipping on council property, 9th October
item.description:
Household waste has been dumped in front yard of this COUNCIL-OWNED property. As such it is the responsibility of the council to intervene. A previous report was closed due to the council stating "that this issue is the responsibility of privately owned organisation" - this is not true, as the owner of the land is Southwark council, and the person likely responsible is a southwark tenant. On-street properties owned by the council should be covered by the same rules that govern estates . If this waste had been dumped by a tenant in a Southwark council housing estate, I am sure you would intervene - as such, I am asking you to please intervene here as well.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 72, Bushey Hill Road, Peckham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
